basic_details.scholarship_name: Concordia University Graduate Fellowship & Research Assistantship in CS & Software Engineering
basic_details.offering_entity: Concordia University Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science & School of Graduate Studies
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Concordia University (Sir George Williams Campus, Montreal, Quebec, Canada)
degree_levels: Master of Applied Science (MASc Software Engineering)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Gina Cody School: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Information Systems Security, Data Science, and Human-Centered Software.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~80 to 110 funded graduate research positions awarded annually across thesis-based Master's and PhD programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international merit competition; Pakistani graduate researchers in computing secure ~8 to 15 fully funded positions annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's (Thesis); up to 4 years for PhD, renewed annually based on satisfactory research progress

nationality_requirements: Open to Canadian and international students of all nationalities (Pakistan eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No formal age limit; evaluated on academic achievement and research capability.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science or Software Engineering with at least B+ standing (minimum 3.30 / 4.30 on Concordia scale, equivalent to CGPA 3.30 / 4.00 or 78%+) for Master's; a research Master's degree in Computer Science with at least A- standing (CGPA 3.60 / 4.00) for PhD from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum B+ standing (3.30/4.30 Concordia scale, equivalent to 78%+ or 3.3/4.0) over the final two years of undergraduate study.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial background in software engineering, algorithms, operating systems, computer systems, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with expected graduation transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior software development, open-source projects, or published research papers in IEEE/ACM venues significantly strengthen candidacy.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 overall (with no sub-score below 6.0), TOEFL iBT minimum 85 (minimum 20 in writing), or Duolingo English Test (DET) minimum 120. Official test reports mandatory.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants must secure supervisory support from a Gina Cody School faculty member prior to final admission approval.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold concurrent full external government fellowships without university approval.

tuition_fee.details: International tuition fees (~CAD 9,000 to 14,000 / year) are offset through International Tuition Differential Fee Waivers and departmental grants, with the balance paid directly out of the guaranteed funding package.
tuition_fee.amount: Covered via funding package (~CAD 10,000 / year; ~PKR 2,050,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Concordia University graduate application fee of CAD 113 (~USD 83; ~PKR 23,165) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus student housing (Grey Nuns Residence) or affordable private rental apartments in Montreal (average CAD 650 to 950 / month; ~USD 480 to 700 / month; Montreal is one of the most affordable major student cities in North America) comfortably paid out of the living stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed minimum funding package: Master's Thesis students receive at least CAD 24,000 / year (~CAD 2,000 / month; ~PKR 410,000 / month); PhD students receive at least CAD 26,000 to 32,000 / year (~CAD 2,166 to 2,666 / month; ~PKR 444,000 to 546,500 / month), composed of Concordia Graduate Fellowship (CGF), Teaching Assistantships (GTA), and Research Assistantships (GRA).

airfare.details: International airfare between Pakistan and Montreal is self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ) fee (CAD 124) and Canadian Study Permit fee (CAD 150) + biometrics (CAD 85) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory International Student Health Insurance Plan (Blue Cross) provides comprehensive healthcare coverage in Quebec, covered directly under the graduate fellowship package (~CAD 1,176 / year value).

food_allowance.details: Living expenses and groceries in Montreal are very affordable compared to Toronto or Vancouver; easily managed within the monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to Concordia Library (Webster Library, Vanier Library), high-performance computing clusters, and Gina Cody School laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Concordia Conference Travel Awards and supervisor research grants provide up to CAD 1,500 to 2,000 for presenting papers at premier conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to CAD 2,000 conference travel funding

travel_transit_allowance.details: Montreal STM public transit (Metro and buses) paid from monthly stipend (~CAD 60/month with student OPUS fare reduction).

participating_institutions: Concordia University - Sir George Williams Campus (Montreal, Quebec, Canada)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #387 worldwide, top 100 in the world for Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, member of the Montreal AI research ecosystem (Mila).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Online Concordia application form, official academic transcripts, curriculum vitae, statement of purpose, official IELTS/TOEFL/DET score report, three academic letters of recommendation, and confirmed faculty supervisor endorsement.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Admission to the Artificial Intelligence and Information Systems Security groups receives fierce competition; establishing early contact with faculty members and demonstrating published research or strong coding projects is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Reach out to prospective supervisors between October and December. Send a concise email attaching your CV, academic transcript, and a 1-page summary of how your technical skills match their current research grants.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant account on Concordia admissions portal, select Computer Science thesis-based program, identify proposed supervisors, and upload digital application documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore faculty research groups and email prospective supervisors with CV and research interests (October - December).
Step 2: Take IELTS (min 6.5) or TOEFL (min 85) and ensure official electronic score reporting to Concordia University.
Step 3: Submit online application on Concordia portal and pay the CAD 113 application fee before the deadline (February 1).
Step 4: Upload unofficial transcripts, CV, and statement of purpose.
Step 5: Academic referees submit confidential appraisal forms via automated institutional links.
Step 6: Prospective supervisors review shortlisted files and conduct online technical interviews (February - March).
Step 7: Departmental Graduate Committee issues formal admission and guaranteed funding offer letters (March - April).
Step 8: Accept the offer, apply for Quebec Acceptance Certificate (CAQ), Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL), and Study Permit via IRCC.
Step 9: Arrive in Montreal in late August for international graduate orientation and commence studies in September.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: All admitted thesis-based graduate students automatically receive the guaranteed minimum funding package without separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure automated links dispatched directly to their institutional email addresses.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose outlining academic background, specific research problems of interest, and reasons for choosing Concordia Computer Science.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 1 to 2-page research outline highlighting technical methodologies and alignment with prospective faculty laboratories.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum vitae detailing education, technical skillsets, research publications, awards, and software projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: 30-minute online video interview conducted by the prospective faculty supervisor focusing on technical depth, programming ability, and research drive.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 85) mandatory; GRE is not required for Computer Science at Concordia.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan and official sealed transcripts sent upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English or French translation required for any documents not issued in English or French.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the Concordia graduate admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for all post-secondary education with minimum B+ / 3.30 GPA equivalent.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scanned color copies of HEC-attested Bachelor's/Master's degrees and semester-by-semester transcripts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2-page essay detailing research interests, background, and alignment with prospective supervisors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must clearly name 2-3 Concordia faculty members whose research aligns with yours.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 6.0 in each subtest), TOEFL iBT (min 85), or DET (min 120).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Request testing agency to send official scores directly to Concordia University (institution code 0956).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential evaluation letters from academic professors who taught or supervised previous research.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from official Pakistani university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed academic CV highlighting technical projects, publications, and programming proficiencies.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to open-source code repositories (GitHub) and published papers.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of passport identification page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must have validity through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Fall semester (September commencement). Applications received by February 1 receive premier funding consideration.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Prior research, publications, technical projects, and supervisor match)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of research intent and problem formulation)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 0% (Interview performance factored directly into supervisor endorsement)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee and individual faculty principal investigators.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-phase evaluation: academic credential audit followed by faculty supervisor sponsorship and guaranteed funding commitment.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,200 to 1,700 international graduate applicants for CS thesis programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~80 to 110 fully funded graduate positions awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~7.0% to 9.0% among competitive applicants with supervisor backing
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.60+ / 4.00 or 80%+ aggregate from leading Pakistani institutions (NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI, UET)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with solid computing fundamentals, strong programming abilities, and at least 1-2 published papers or substantial research thesis outcomes.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani top computer science and software engineering programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Canada, Iran, China, India, Pakistan, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent educational consultancy agencies claiming guaranteed admission or funding packages to Concordia.
Legitimate applications are processed exclusively through concordia.ca.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Concordia application fee is CAD 113 paid securely via the official portal; never pay fees to third-party brokers.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Concordia University does not partner with recruitment agents for research-based graduate admissions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Quebec CAQ and Canadian Study Permit fees: ~CAD 359 (~PKR 73,500).
Initial settling-in expenses upon arrival in Montreal: ~CAD 1,200 (~PKR 246,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You must speak French to study at Concordia. Reality: Concordia is an English-language university; all courses and research are conducted 100% in English.
Myth: You can get admitted to thesis Master's without a supervisor. Reality: Gina Cody School thesis programs require a confirmed faculty supervisor before formal admission is granted.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim GRE is required; GRE is NOT required for Computer Science at Concordia.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.30 (Grade B) in graduate coursework throughout the degree program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus academic standing and active participation in assigned laboratory research projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual Progress Report reviewed by the supervisory committee and the Graduate Program Director; satisfactory progress required for funding renewal.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching/research assistantships are limited to an average of 10-12 hours per week during academic terms to prioritize thesis research.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return requirement; graduates are eligible for the Canadian Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) for up to 3 years.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bond or repayment obligation attached to the funding package.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding discontinued if student withdraws without authorization or is dismissed for academic dishonesty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires formal re-application and approval by the new academic department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for the standard program duration (2 years for Master's, 4 years for PhD); extensions are contingent on supervisor grant availability.
